acquisition.details: Ran `cargo test` after adding failure-mode fixtures. Result: 17 unit tests passed and 25 integration tests passed. Coverage includes watcher nonzero-exit isolation with daemon liveness and subsequent sibling watcher run, daemon-down `eyes hook fetch` silent success with empty stdout/stderr, queued message visibility through hook fetch after daemon restart, same-project cursor isolation, and non-git file-only watch behavior with empty git diff context but successful watcher/hook delivery.
